_readme: Manual corrections applied on top of whatever tools/sync-lots.py pulls from the
developer's plat app. Anything set here wins, so a re-sync will not undo it.
Key residential lots by their label, e.g. "Lot 102".
Key commercial pads by phase and pad number, e.g. "Commercial P2-3".
Fields you can set: status (available | reserved | sold | pre-sale),
Setting status to sold automatically hides the price on the map.
